descricao_original: A lobule of the inactive breast consists almost entirely of branching ducts surrounded by connective tissue proper and adipose tissue. Intralobular connective tissue is loose, corresponding to the papillary layer of the dermis; interlobular connective tissue corresponds to the dense irregular connective tissue of the reticular layer of the dermis. 100x
